s.how: Cut 1 pineapple, 2 mangoes, 1 rockmelon and 250g strawberries and arrange on a platter. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.
Crumb 600g chicken strips and fry until golden. Put in 12 slider buns with coleslaw and pickles. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.note: getting the Style Boyz back together
m.how: Grill 600g white fish with chilli and lime and flake. Serve in 12 tortillas with salsa of 1 mango, red onion and coriander. Bring it to the middle of the table so everyone helps themselves.

w.how: Beat 200g butter and 100g icing sugar, add 1 egg yolk and 300g flour. Roll, cut 16 circles and bake at 170C for 12 minutes. Ice with grey icing and a small dot in the middle.

d.how: Fill 4 glasses with ice, cucumber, mint and lime and top with sparkling water. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
